name: presence-chip
title: PresenceChip widget with PresenceVariant enum
conventions_reminder: enum PresenceVariant defined at top-level (not nested)
3 named factory constructors delegating to default
showIcon toggles icon visibility via avatar parameter
Double quotes on all string literals
acceptance_criteria: Public API: PresenceChip({required PresenceVariant variant, required String label, bool showIcon = true})
3 factory constructors: PresenceChip.present/absent/pending with optional label override
Each variant uses correct semantic color (present=success, absent=error, pending=warning)
showIcon=false renders chip without icon using base AppChip constructor
completion_summary: Implemented PresenceChip with PresenceVariant enum (present/absent/pending), 3 factory constructors with pt-BR defaults, showIcon toggle, delegates to AppChip with semantic colors (success/error/warning) and appropriate icons
